messages.content:
You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value (as written, then in normal form in brackets), sometimes a condition,
and the place it comes from. Some facts carry a note computed from the dates: trust the notes.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the facts, one by one, before you answer.
  A repeal, a limit or an application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a
  date is still fully in force, with everything it permits, on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does
  not yet bind on earlier days.
- If a note says that a date quoted in a condition was corrected, reason with the corrected date.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the
  facts: one item per fact, without article numbers or comments inside the items. Facts filed under the same
  article, annex part or numbered point belong together: a part's members are the facts filed under its points.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "for how long" alone is "duration";
  "can / may / is / does" is "boolean"; "which / what (several things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition,
  or who does something and within what time is "text", and the text names every element asked for.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "the facts and dates compared, step by step, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: For how long must the employer keep the results of the checks on work equipment?

Facts:

[20] digital EU declarations of conformity — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: in any event] [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[21] datore di lavoro, controllo iniziale delle attrezzature di lavoro — hasObligation — dopo l'installazione e prima della messa in esercizio (dopo l'installazione e prima della messa in esercizio) [condition: attrezzature di lavoro la cui sicurezza dipende dalle condizioni di installazione] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 8]
[22] datore di lavoro, controllo dopo ogni montaggio — hasObligation — dopo ogni montaggio in un nuovo cantiere o in una nuova località di impianto (dopo ogni montaggio in un nuovo cantiere o in una nuova località di impianto) [condition: attrezzature di lavoro la cui sicurezza dipende dalle condizioni di installazione] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 8]

[24] digital EU declarations of incorporation — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the placing on the market of the partly completed machinery] [REG, Art. 11(8)]
[25] modalità di effettuazione delle verifiche periodiche — hasTimeLimit — entro dodici mesi (P12M) [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 13]

[27] attrezzature di lavoro — mustAccompany — un documento attestante (un documento attestante l'esecuzione dell'ultimo controllo con esito positivo) [condition: Qualora le attrezzature di lavoro di cui al comma 8 siano usate al di fuori della sede dell'unità produttiva] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 10]
[28] prima verifica INAIL — hasTimeLimit — quarantacinque giorni (P45D) [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 11]
[29] portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery — placingAllowedUntil — Until 29 June 2011 (2011-06-29) [condition: which are in conformity with the national provisions in force upon adoption of this Directive] [DIR, Art. 27]
[30] manufacturers — hasObligation — keep a register of complaints (keep a register of complaints, of non-conforming machinery or related products and machinery or related product recalls) [condition: If necessary] [REG, Art. 10(4)]
[31] datore di lavoro, costi delle verifiche — hasObligation — le spese per la loro effettuazione sono poste a carico del datore di lavoro (le spese per la loro effettuazione sono poste a carico del datore di lavoro) [condition: Le verifiche di cui al presente comma sono effettuate a titolo oneroso] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 11]
[32] 2.3(c) machinery — requiresMeasure — automatic brake (automatic brake) [condition: if there is a risk of contact with the tool whilst it runs down] [DIR, Annex I, 2.3]
[33] chi noleggia o concede in uso attrezzature di lavoro — hasObligation — deve, al momento della cessione, attestarne il buono stato di conservazione (attestare il buono stato di conservazione, manutenzione ed efficienza al momento della cessione) [condition: attrezzature di lavoro senza operatore] [DLGS72, art. 72, c. 2]

[35] essential requirement 1.2.4.1 workstation stop — requiresMeasure — control device (control device) [condition: depending on the existing hazards] [DIR, Annex I, 1.2.4.1]
[36] Attrezzature/insiemi contenenti fluidi del gruppo 1 (D.lgs. 93/2000 art. 3) Recipienti/insiemi classificati in I e II categoria. — verificationInterval — Verifica di integrità: decennale (P10Y) [condition: Verifica di integrità] [DLGSALLVII, Allegato VII, riga 20]
[37] manufacturers — hasObligation — carry out sample testing (carry out sample testing of machinery or related products made available on the market) [condition: When deemed appropriate with regard to the risks presented by machinery or related products] [REG, Art. 10(4)]
[38] portable hand-held machinery, point 2.2.1(c) — addressesRisk — accidental starting or continued operation (accidental starting or continued operation) [condition: equivalent steps shall be taken if this requirement is not technically feasible] [REG, Annex III, 2.2.1]
[39] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — a test report detailing the static and dynamic tests (test report on static and dynamic tests) [condition: where appropriate] [DIR, Annex I, 4.4.2]
[40] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — a test report (a test report) [condition: where appropriate] [REG, Annex III, 4.4.2]
[41] machinery for working wood, tool run-down — requiresMeasure — automatic brake (automatic brake) [condition: if there is a risk of contact with the tool whilst it runs down] [REG, Annex III, 2.3]

[43] manufacturer — hasObligation — perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed (perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed) [condition: In order to verify that the relevant parts of the machinery or related product comply with the requirements set out in sections 2.4.5.1 and 2.4.5.2, for each type of machinery or related product concerned] [REG, Annex III, 2.4.5.3]
[44] datore di lavoro, interventi di controllo straordinari — hasObligation — ogni volta che intervengano eventi eccezionali (ogni volta che intervengano eventi eccezionali) [condition: eventi eccezionali che possano avere conseguenze pregiudizievoli per la sicurezza delle attrezzature di lavoro] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 8]

[47] machinery not referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — internal checks on the manufacture (internal checks on the manufacture) [condition: Where the machinery is not referred to in Annex IV] [DIR, Art. 12(2)]
[48] essential requirement 1.1.5, tools and machinery parts — requiresMeasure — Special arrangements must be made for the handling of tools (special arrangements must be made for the handling of tools) [condition: which, even if lightweight, could be hazardous] [DIR, Annex I, 1.1.5]
[49] Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali — verificationInterval — Verifiche annuali (P1Y) [condition: con portata superiore a 200 Kg. non azionati a mano, di tipo fisso, con modalità di utilizzo riscontrabili in settori di impiego quali costruzioni, siderurgico, portuale, estrattivo e con anno di fabbricazione antecedente 10 anni] [DLGSALLVII, Allegato VII, riga 15]
[50] original declaration of incorporation — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [DIR, Annex II, 2]

response.text: {"reasoning": "The question asks how long the employer must keep the results of the checks on work equipment. Fact 23 covers exactly this: the results of the checks under paragraph 8 must be kept for the last three years, with the condition that at least those relating to the last three years are kept. No other fact addresses the employer's retention of inspection results, so the answer is P3Y. The retention periods for manufacturers' technical documentation (10 years, 15 years) do not apply to employers.", "kind": "duration", "value": "P3Y", "text": "Under Legislative Decree 81/2008 art. 71, paragraph 9, the employer must keep the results of the checks referred to in paragraph 8 for at least the last three years (P3Y).", "used": [23]}
